items.title_orig: Eddie Vedder Playing Two Nights in Brazil
items.article_text: The Ten Club has announced that Eddie is headed to Brazil this November for 2 headlining nights at Best of Blues and Rock 2026! These special performances will take place on Friday, November 20 and Sunday, November 22 at Ibirapuera Park in São Paulo, Brazil.

items.title_orig: Better Believe by Eddie Vedder and Guitars Over Guns
items.article_text:
Eddie Vedder joined Chicago musicians, Guitars Over Guns, at Columbia College Chicago to record a collaboration, "Better Believe" which they then debuted life at the grand opening of the Obama Presidential Center.

No word on physical media, but they did announced all proceeds will benefit the Obama Foundation.

items.title_orig: Pearl Jam March Madness Champion: ANIMAL!
items.article_text:
It's official! Our 2026 Pearl Jam March Madness champion has been determined, and it is Animal. This is the first time the song has topped our tournament. Was the drummer breakdown the key to victory, who can tell, but enjoy a good rock out to this classic that highlights all that Dave Abbruzzese has to offer.

#pearljam

items.title_orig: Pearl Jam March Madness: The Finals
items.article_text:
The battle of the drummers is about to come to and end.  Two songs are left standing, and you have the weekend to choose the winner of it all.

Will it be Dave Abbruzzese on ANIMAL?

Or will it be Jack Irons on BRAIN OF J?
The band will also be hitting the road in June to play Missoula on June 20th, Big Sandy on June 27th, and Dana Point, CA on September 26th!

items.title_orig: Pearl Jam March Madness: FINAL FOUR
items.article_text:
BRAIN OF J vs. DO THE EVOLUTION

Animal is the only song that's never won the tournament before. Can it pull off a Cinderella Story? Do The Evolution is the only choice that's won twice. Can it 3peat? Only your votes can determine the winner.  Head over to our retro forum and cast your votes.

Last year, Neil Young released his album, Mirror Ball, recorded with "The Band" as part of a 4-album boxed set. Now Pearl Jam fans can get their hands on the stand alone album.  The official release date is May 22nd.  You can pre-order the remastered CD or vinyl at Ten Club or your favorite record stores.

No word on the companion piece, Merkinball, featuring I Got Shit and Long Road.  We're hoping for a orange sherbert swirl vinyl 12-inch single.

Pearl Jam announced today that Ohana Fest is happening this year in September and will feature Eddie Vedder on September 25th, Jeff Ament's punk project, P.E.S.T., on September 26th, and PEARL JAM on September 27th.  Speculation on Pearl Jam's drummer will now hit the roof, but nothing has been announced or hinted at.

Fan Club tickets are available now, and general sale starts on Thursday, May 14th.

Today, Pearl Jam posted a "Dead End" sign on their X.com feed.  Is this a message about something upcoming? A new spin on Yield? A break-up announcement?

No, it hasn't been repeated on their other socials (BlueSky, Facebook, Instagram).  We're probably looking at a decision by the band to stop using X.com.

I hope I'm wrong and this is news about some cool, upcoming project.  We're expecting a Fan Club newsletter on Sunday.  Maybe we'll find out more then!
